evidence.title: Statistical Machine Translation Systems of English-Pnar Language Pair : Some Insights of the Emperical Study

summary: Researchers evaluated statistical machine translation systems for the English‑Pnar language pair, a low‑resource language rarely addressed in prior work. The study presents performance metrics, error analysis, and recommendations for improving translation quality in such under‑represented languages.
title: Statistical Machine Translation for English-Pnar: Insights from Empirical Study
